description: This Java class implements the MedicationDispenseService interface for managing MedicationDispense objects in the OpenMRS system, providing methods for retrieval, saving, voiding, unvoiding, and deleting medication dispense records.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the MedicationDispenseService interface for managing medication dispense records.

methods.name: setMedicationDispenseDAO
methods.description: Setter for dependency injection of the MedicationDispenseDAO.

methods.name: getMedicationDispense
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense object by its ID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense object by its UUID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MedicationDispense objects matching given criteria.

methods.name: saveMedicationDispense
methods.description: Saves or updates a MedicationDispense object.

methods.name: voidMedicationDispense
methods.description: Voids a MedicationDispense, requiring a reason; actual void logic handled elsewhere.

methods.name: purgeMedicationDispense
methods.description: Deletes a MedicationDispense from the database.
